title: Rotation Schema
description: Rotation model: a Rotation owns a set of Menus via menu entries, each with a planned and consumed count. Users 'affirm' a Menu they ate; consumedCount increments and the rotation drains over time. Also covers shopping list, AI recipe, and food lookup payloads driven from the rotation flow.

RotationStatus.description: Lifecycle state of a Rotation. staged = being built (on deck); active = currently eating through it (at bat)

Rotation.description: A user-owned rotation: a set of Menus the user is currently eating through, sized for a target span and people count.

spanDays.description: How many days the rotation covers (2–10)

peopleCount.description: Number of people the menus are sized for (1–10)

pinDay.description: Day of week the user typically starts (e.g. 'Monday'). Optional — the UX adapts if absent.

pinDate.description: Optional calendar anchor date (YYYY-MM-DD). When set, enables day-count display and macro budget balance tracking.

createdAt.description: When the rotation was first created

updatedAt.description: When the rotation was last modified

CreateRotationRequest.description: Request body for POST /api/rotation — creates an empty rotation skeleton (no menus yet)

spanDays.description: How many days the rotation covers (2–10)

peopleCount.description: Number of people the menus are sized for (1–10). Defaults to 1.

pinDay.description: Day of week the user typically starts (e.g. 'Monday'). Optional.

UpdateRotationRequest.description: Request body for PATCH /api/rotation/{id} — all fields optional; only provided fields are updated

MacroTargetsHit.description: Which of the user's daily macro targets the day's menu satisfies

protein.description: True when the day's protein target is hit

fiber.description: True when the day's fiber target is hit

carbsUnderCeiling.description: True when the day's carbs are under the user's ceiling

fatAboveFloor.description: True when the day's fat is above the user's floor

RotationMenuEntry.description: One menu entry in a Rotation — a Menu with its planned and consumed counts

menuId.description: Menu attached to this menu entry

pinned.description: Whether the referenced Menu is Pinned (in the Binder)

plannedCount.description: How many times this Menu appears in the rotation

consumedCount.description: Incremented when a DailyLog using this Menu is finalized

sortOrder.description: Display order in the rotation's menus panel

createdAt.description: When the menu entry was created

RotationDetail.description: GET /api/rotation/{id} response: the rotation header plus its menus

spanDays.description: How many days the rotation covers (2–10)

peopleCount.description: Number of people the menus are sized for (1–10)

pinDay.description: Day of week the user typically starts (e.g. 'Monday'). Optional.

createdAt.description: When the rotation was first created

updatedAt.description: When the rotation was last modified

menus.description: The Menus in this rotation and their consumption counts

menuId.description: Menu to add to the rotation

plannedCount.description: How many times this Menu should appear in the rotation

sortOrder.description: Display order in the rotation's menus panel

plannedCount.description: New planned count for this menu entry

sortOrder.description: New display order in the rotation's menus panel

MenuMacros.description: Aggregate macro totals for a menu or a slot

MenuSlot.description: One slot in a Menu. Slot order maps 1→A, 2→B, … 10→J via SlotOrderToLabel.

slotLabel.description: Display letter computed from slotOrder (A–J). Read-only; clients should not send it.

slotName.description: Optional user-set label for the slot (e.g., 'breakfast', 'lunch'). Null when unnamed.

mealId.description: Meal attached to this slot. Null when empty or dining-out.

mealName.description: Denormalized meal name for display. Null when no meal is attached.

mealType.description: Denormalized meal type for display. Null when no meal is attached.

isDiningOut.description: True when the user marked this slot as dining out — the slot is intentionally empty

Menu.description: A reusable named menu — an ordered list of slots, each of which may hold a Meal

slotCount.description: Number of slots in the menu (1–10)

isYeh.description: True when this menu is an admin-curated YEH menu visible to all users

pinned.description: Binder flag — 1 = pinned menu (survives rotation teardown; only explicit delete kills it), 0 = disposable

totalCalories.description: Cached total calories across all slots

totalProteinG.description: Cached total protein (g) across all slots

totalFatG.description: Cached total fat (g) across all slots

totalCarbG.description: Cached total carbohydrate (g) across all slots

totalFiberG.description: Cached total fiber (g) across all slots

totalSodiumMg.description: Cached total sodium (mg) across all slots

slots.description: All slots in the menu, ordered by slotOrder ascending

createdAt.description: When the menu was first created

updatedAt.description: When the menu was last modified

MenuSummary.description: Lightweight menu reference. Slots and macros are optional for skeleton listings; note carries a reuse hint when the same menu appears multiple times.

slots.description: Optional slot list — included on detail responses, omitted on lightweight skeleton responses

note.description: Optional reuse hint, e.g. "Reused — same as Day N"

CreateMenuRequest.description: Request body for POST /api/menu — creates an empty menu with N empty slots

name.description: Display name for the menu (server defaults if omitted)

slotCount.description: Number of slots to create (1–10). Defaults to 4.

UpdateMenuRequest.description: Request body for PATCH /api/menu/{id} — all fields optional

pinned.description: Pin (1) into the Binder or unpin (0). Flipping 0→1 cascades Pinned=1 to every meal the menu's slots reference.

AssignMealToSlotRequest.description: Request body for POST /api/menu/{id}/slots/{slotOrder}/meal — attaches an existing meal to a slot

mealId.description: ID of the Meal to attach

SetSlotNameRequest.description: Request body for PUT /api/menu/{id}/slots/{slotOrder}/name — sets or clears the user-defined name on a slot

slotName.description: New slot name. Null explicitly clears any existing name.

SetDiningOutRequest.description: Request body for PUT /api/menu/{id}/slots/{slotOrder}/dining-out — marks a slot as dining out (or clears the flag)

isDiningOut.description: True to mark the slot as dining out; false to clear the flag

ShoppingItem.description: One line item on a shopping list

foodName.description: Food name as it should appear on the list

scaledQuantity.description: Quantity scaled by rotation peopleCount and meal servings

usedInMeals.description: Optional list of meal names that contribute to this quantity

usedInMenus.description: Optional list of menu names that contribute to this quantity

productPurchaseLink.description: Optional pre-baked purchase link (e.g., Amazon URL)

isStaple.description: True when the item is a pantry staple

isUntracked.description: True when the item is an untracked freeform entry

ShoppingCategory.description: A named grouping of shopping items (e.g., 'Produce', 'Protein')

rotationName.description: Display name of the source rotation

peopleCount.description: People count the quantities were scaled to

generatedAt.description: When the shopping list was generated

untrackedItems.description: Freeform untracked items collected from meals

stapleItems.description: Pantry staple items pulled in from user prefs / curated lists
